'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] destroy the last remaining bridge leading to [[Sievierodonetsk]] in [[Luhansk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], trapping all remaining Ukrainian civilians in the city, according to regional governor [[Serhiy Haidai]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/all-bridges-ukraines-sievierodontesk-destroyed-access-remains-governor-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****The [[Donetsk People's Republic]] says that five people have been killed and 22 others injured in an [[artillery]] attack on a [[marketplace]] in central [[Donetsk]]. Pro-Russian media accuses [[NATO]] of supplying the munitions used in the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/three-killed-artillery-attack-donetsk-market-separatist-news-agency-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[2022 M23 offensive]], [[2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels capture the town of [[Bunagana, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Bunagana]]. The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese military]] accuses [[Rwanda]] of assisting the rebels in the capture of the town. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/13/m23-rebels-seize-key-congolese-town-drc-blames-rwanda (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**Global stocks and government bonds plunge with the [[MSCI World|MSCI World Index]] dropping by 2.95%, the [[Dow Jones Industrial Average|DOW]] by 4.68%, the [[S&P 500]] by 3.88%, [[STOXX Europe 600]] by 2.41%, [[Japan]]'s [[Nikkei 225]] by 3.01%, [[Hong Kong]]'s [[Hang Seng Index|Hang Seng]] by 3.99%, and [[South Korea]]'s [[KOSPI]] by 3.52%. [[Bitcoin]] drops by 12.1% and [[Ethereum]] by 13.6%. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/global-markets-wrapup-1-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/bitcoin-falls-121-23366-2022-06-13/ (Reuters 2)]
**The [[S&P 500]] closes more than 20% below its January 3 record closing high, confirming that the index is in a [[bear market]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-tumble-3-aggressive-rate-hike-bets-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Vila-seca train crash]]
**A [[passenger train]] and a [[locomotive]] [[train wreck|collide]] in the town of [[Vila-seca]], [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]], injuring 22 people. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-business-barcelona-spain-733cec0f5096d29033ea94b1715966b4 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]] for a second time. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canadian-pm-trudeau-tests-positive-covid-19-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[United States Secretary of Health and Human Services|Secretary of Health and Human Services]] [[Xavier Becerra]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/3521555-health-secretary-becerra-tests-positive-for-covid-19-twice-in-less-than-a-month/amp/ (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
***[[Taiwan]] reports their first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron]] BA.4 and BA.5 subvariants in five [[Taiwanese people|Taiwanese citizens]] who arrived from overseas. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/taiwan-reports-first-cases-of-new-omicron-sub-variants (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship of Wikipedia]]
**The [[Wikimedia Foundation]] files an appeal against a Russian court order demanding the removal of certain [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]-related information from the [[Russian Wikipedia|Russian-language Wikipedia]], which is one of the few remaining [[Fact-checking|fact-check]]ed sources still available to the general Russian public. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/wikipedia-fights-russian-order-remove-ukraine-war-information-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/wikipedia-challenges-russian-order-to-remove-ukraine-war-information/a-62117507 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Brexit and the Irish border]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] confirms that it will go ahead with plans to terminate the [[Northern Ireland Protocol]] in order to make it easier for goods to flow between [[Great Britain]] and [[Northern Ireland]]. The [[European Union]] accuses the UK of breaking [[international law]] by reneging on the agreement made during [[Brexit negotiations]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-61790248 (BBC News)]
*[[Pope Francis]] appoints [[John T. Dunlap]] as the new [[List of Princes and Grand Masters of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta|Lieutenant of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta]]. [https://www.orderofmalta.int/fra-john-t-dunlap-is-the-new-lieutenant-of-the-grand-master/ (Order of Malta)]
*Indigenous peoples in [[Ecuador]] block highways leading to the capital [[Quito]], to protest president [[Guillermo Lasso]]'s policies and to call for economic reforms. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-indigenous-groups-block-road-protest-economic-policies-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)]
